outcome: fetal cardiac functions (Myocardial Performance Index - MPI, isovolumetric relaxation time, isovolumetric contraction time, systolic functions)
cohort: The study evaluated 35 pregnant patients diagnosed with GDM and 35 pregnant patients without glucose intolerance, along with their babies.
finding: The Myocardial Performance Index (MPI) was significantly higher in the GDM group, and postpartum need for hospitalization was more frequently observed in GDM.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the mode of delivery between the GDM and control groups.
cross-section timing: Fetal evaluations were performed during pregnancy, with some immediate postpartum observations for birth outcomes.
